description: This is a CMake module script for finding and configuring the GBM (Generic Buffer Management) library. It sets up the necessary variables, checks for dependencies, and creates an imported target for GBM if found.

methods.name: find_package
methods.description: Locates and loads settings for a package, in this case, PkgConfig.

methods.name: pkg_check_modules
methods.description: Checks for the presence of a package configuration module, here for 'gbm'.

methods.name: find_library
methods.description: Finds a library file, here for 'gbm'.

methods.name: find_path
methods.description: Finds the directory containing a specific header file, here 'gbm.h'.

methods.name: find_package_handle_standard_args
methods.description: Verifies that all required variables are set after attempting to find a package.

methods.name: add_library
methods.description: Creates an imported library target for GBM.

methods.name: set_target_properties
methods.description: Sets properties for the imported target, such as location and include directories.

methods.name: mark_as_advanced
methods.description: Marks variables as advanced to hide them in GUIs.

calls: set_target_properties(GBM::GBM PROPERTIES IMPORTED_LOCATION "${GBM_ACTUAL_LIBRARY}" INTERFACE_LINK_LIBRARIES "${PC_GBM_LIBRARIES}" INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS "${PC_GBM_CFLAGS}" INTERFACE_INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES "${GBM_INCLUDE_DIR}")
